news.html:
Please read carefully.  Lots of details this week.

CHOIR DURING REVIVAL - Caleb asked if the choir should be on stage for the congregationals during the revival.  We will not.  Since attendance for the revival is based on weeknight availability, the choir won't be on stage for the congregationals. 

CHOIR REHEARSAL TIME CHANGE - Now that we will be starting new Thanksgiving and Christmas music, we will start our evening choir practices at 5:00pm beginning this Sunday, Oct. 18 through December.  One exception will be on Oct. 25 for the Lord's Supper. That night we will practice from 4:45 to 5:15 in the chapel.

FROM PASTOR -  I shared with you a concern from Pastor at the end of rehearsal but wanted to include it in our weekly email for those who weren't able to be at practice last night.

Pastor is concerned that some choir members are leaving after the evening practice and not staying for the evening service and also some that are staying through the choir song for the evening service but not staying for the preaching.  I understand that there might be an instance when this can't be avoided so please text or speak to me when it does. Please be faithful in all things.  Thank you.

EVENING CHOIR PRACTICES TIMES/LOCATIONS

Oct. 18 - in auditorium at 5:00

Oct. 25 -  in the chapel 4:45-5:15 (Lord's Supper)

Nov. 1 - back in the auditorium at 5:00
